newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil soybean crop eight pct harvested - Safras.
newsitem.headline: Brazil soybean crop eight pct harvested - Safras.

text.p: Around eight percent of Brazil's expected soybean crop had been harvested by February 27, a new record for the period, consultants Safras e Mercado said in its first harvest survey.

The eight percent compares with four percent by February 29, 1996, although this was following delayed plantings which were also hit by a drought which hit a large part of the center-south region, Safras said.
Initial results are still pointing to a harvest of between 26 million and 27 million tonnes, a new national record.
Crop conditions are generally very good at the moment after a rainy start to February.
In the last 10 days, rainfall has dropped considerably, with rainy days alternating with sunny days, exactly what soybeans need, Safras said.
A breakdown of percentage harvested by state follows.
Rio Grande do Sul 0 0
Parana 10 2
Mato Grosso 20 12
Mato Grosso do Sul 10 8

RIO GRANDE DO SUL - good weather conditions with regular rains have returned to the region. Harvest only due to begin from the second half of March but expectations are between 5.8 million and six million tonnes.

MATO GROSSO - drop-off in rains has helped harvest operations start up again. Some possible problems with excess moisture which leave open the prospect of a five million to 5.4 million tonne crop. Of the 20 percent already harvested, yields are between 2,400 and 2,700 kgs per hectare.

GOIAS - alternating rainy and sunny weather has helped the crop's development. Yields seen in the 15 percent harvested to-date are around 2,400 kgs per hectare and crop seen at 2.3 million to 2.5 million tonnes.

MATO GROSSO DO SUL - could not have better weather. Most of the 10 percent already harvested is in the south of the country. Uncertainty over yields which could be higher than anticipated and also planted area means crop could range between two million to 2.3 million tonnes.
Goias 15 8
Sao Paulo 14 6
Minas Gerais 0 2
Others 0 1
TOTAL BRAZIL 8 4

PARANA - last few days have seen active harvesting in the western areas and the start of harvesting of the early crop in the north of the state. Average yields are around 2,650 kgs per hectare, with total production seen between 6.6 million and 6.8 million tonnes

GOIAS - alternating rainy and sunny weather has helped the crop's development. Yields seen in the 15 percent harvested to-date are around 2,400 kgs per hectare and crop seen at 2.3 million to 2.5 million tonnes MATO GROSSO DO SUL - could not have better weather. Most of the 10 percent already harvested is in the south of the country. Uncertainty over yields which could be higher than anticipated and also planted area means crop could range between two million to 2.3 million tonnes

SAO PAULO - active harvesting in the last few days. Of the 14 percent already collected, yields are between 2,300 and 2,400 kgs per hectare, leading to forecasts of a 1.3 million to 1.4 million tonne crop MINAS GERAIS - harvest still to begin and some uncertainty over yields following dry weather during flowering period and excess rains during January and part of February. But good weather since then means crop should be 1.2 million to 1.3 million tonnes
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
